subject: Probe materials exchange — conditional MAP and usage snapshot
messages:
From: Marta Silva <marta@retailco.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Priyanka Rao <pri.procurement@retailco.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Probe materials exchange — MAP request and constraints

Jonas,

Thanks for the productive demo last week. RetailCo is ready to share a scoped probe dataset and prompt pack so your team can run a short acceptance pass. Before we transfer materials we need a brief mutual action plan (MAP) that captures:

- scope of artifacts (list of files, sample sizes)
- access model (ephemeral sandbox, no external redistribution)
- retention window for the artifacts and logs
- explicit prohibition on training models with the supplied testcases
- acceptance criteria & takedown process

We'd like to keep the initial exchange limited to a small staging environment (non-production) and have the artifacts removed after 90 days unless a separate agreement is signed. We also require basic audit logging (who accessed what & when) for the full retention period.

Can you send a one-page MAP and proposed timeline (intake -> staging -> acceptance -> takedown)? We aim to start ingestion week of 7/12. I've attached our request summary (RetailCo_MAP_Request.pdf).

Also looping DataOps (<dataops@datalabs.com>), who will push the payload, and Priyanka in procurement for contracting.

Best,
Marta Silva
Head of Machine Learning Programs
RetailCo

[Attachment: RetailCo_MAP_Request.pdf (1 page summary)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta@retailco.com>
Cc: Priyanka Rao <pri.procurement@retailco.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Probe materials exchange — MAP request and constraints

Hi Marta — thanks, and glad to hear you're ready to move forward. Attached is a concise draft MAP and a short ingestion checklist to make the handoff straightforward: MAP_draft_Redwood_v1.pdf and ingestion-checklist.xlsx. High level proposal below:

1) Intake (3 business days): data transfer via S3 presigned share or secure SFTP; DataOps to confirm checksum list.
2) Staging (5 business days): artifacts loaded into a sandbox account with isolated GPU nodes; read-only access for RetailCo reviewers.
3) Acceptance testing (7 business days): Redwood runs predefined acceptance prompts; RetailCo validates results against acceptance pass/fail criteria.
4) Takedown (within 72 hours of expiry or earlier on request): artifacts destroyed; retention snapshot (audit logs) retained per MAP.

Minimum security & usage constraints we propose:
- No model training on supplied testcases (explicit clause).
- Ephemeral compute; artifacts only on staging nodes with encrypted disks.
- Watermarking/fingerprint on prompt packs to detect leakage.
- Access by named Redwood engineers and approved RetailCo reviewers; RBAC and IP allowlist.

Proposed timeline: start ingest 2027-07-12, staging complete by 2027-07-19, acceptance window 7/19–7/26, takedown by 2027-10-26 (90-day retention from staging).

Can you confirm if the 90-day retention is acceptable or if you prefer a shorter window? If the MAP looks good we can route this to Legal for a short MPA (mutual protection agreement) and send a DocuSign envelope. Suggested sync: Wed 7/7 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 7/8 13:00–13:30 PT. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/retailco

Thanks — attaching drafts.

—Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: MAP_draft_Redwood_v1.pdf, ingestion-checklist.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Draft MAP - compliance notes (do not forward)

Jonas / Marissa — quick review of the draft MAP you circulated. Primary redlines and documentation requests below (we should send as an appendix to the MAP):

- Retention: customer requested 90 days. Recommend compromise to 60 days with option to extend to 75 days on mutual written agreement. We need explicit language that Redwood will not use these artifacts for model training.
- Audit logs: retain access logs for 12 months for incident response (log snapshots only, not dataset contents).
- Evidence: RetailCo must provide a network diagram and the lead reviewer SSO contact prior to ingestion.
- Technical controls: encrypted at rest (AES-256), keys via customer KMS where feasible; IP allowlist for staging; ephemeral nodes will be reclaimed immediately after takedown.
- Liability: add a narrow clause limiting Redwood liability for inadvertent exposure during transit if carrier (S3 presigned) is used, and require verification checksums on receipt.

Please incorporate these as tracked redlines in MAP_draft_Redwood_v1.pdf and include security_req_checklist.pdf with the transfer. I'll join the 7/7 sync if scheduled.

Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: security_req_checklist.pdf]

From: Marta Silva <marta@retailco.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Rao <pri.procurement@retailco.com>, DataOps Labs <dataops@datalabs.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Probe materials exchange — MAP request and constraints

Jonas, Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and for surfacing the compliance asks. We can accept the controls you propose with two adjustments:

1) Retention — RetailCo prefers a compromise of 75 days retention for the artifacts and 12 months for audit logs. That aligns operationally with our review cycles.
2) DocuSign — please send the final MAP/MPA via DocuSign and we'll have procurement (Priyanka) review & sign. We will not allow model training on the supplied cases.

Confirmed timeline: ingest 7/12; staging 7/12–7/19; acceptance 7/19–7/26. We can meet Wed 7/7 10:00 PT for a quick intake call (30 min). Priyanka — looping you to start the procurement intake.

Next steps: Redwood to circulate final MAP with Kimberly's redlines incorporated and DocuSign link. We'll prepare the artifact bundle and checksum manifest next week.

Best,
Marta Silva
Head of Machine Learning Programs
RetailCo

[Attachment: RetailCo_Signed_SOW_stub.pdf (placeholder for internal procurement reference)]
